name: Food Bill Assistant for Medical & Engineering Students of SEBC
benefit:
- **Financial Assistance:** 
  - ₹300/- per month (₹3,000/- annually) towards mess charges for most eligible SEBC students.
  - ₹700/- per month (₹7,000/- annually) towards mess charges for selected students (limited number of beneficiaries).
  - ₹1,500/- per month (₹15,000/- annually) for SEBC students studying in self-financed medical/engineering colleges and residing in hostels (with a fixed ce
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC). 1. The applicant should be pursuing a Medical or Engineering degree in a recognized institution. 1. The applicant must have passed HSC (Class 12th).1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-. 1. The applicant who is already availing similar mess assistance under any other government scheme is not eligible.
